Name: Pokémon Red
Description: One of the original Pokémon games in which the player explores the Kanto region, catches and trains Pokémon, and battles Gym Leaders to become Champion.

Name: Pokémon Blue
Description: Companion version to Pokémon Red, released simultaneously in Japan, featuring the same core adventure with a few different Pokémon available.

Name: Super Mario Bros.
Description: A side-scrolling platform game in which Mario travels across the Mushroom Kingdom to rescue Princess Toadstool from Bowser.

Name: Super Mario Bros. 3
Description: Mario and Luigi journey through the Mushroom World across eight kingdoms to defeat Bowser's Koopalings and rescue Princess Toadstool.

Name: The Legend of Zelda
Description: Link explores the kingdom of Hyrule, collecting pieces of the Triforce of Wisdom to defeat Ganon and rescue Princess Zelda.

Name: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time
Description: Link travels between childhood and adulthood using the Ocarina of Time to stop Ganondorf from conquering Hyrule.

Name: The Legend of Zelda: Breath of the Wild
Description: An open-world reimagining of the Zelda series in which Link awakens after a century of slumber to defeat Calamity Ganon and save Hyrule.

Name: Grand Theft Auto V
Description: An open-world crime game following three protagonists — Michael, Franklin, and Trevor — as they pull off heists in the fictional city of Los Santos.

Name: Red Dead Redemption 2
Description: A Western epic following outlaw Arthur Morgan and the Van der Linde gang as they fight to survive against the encroaching forces of civilization.

Name: God of War
Description: Kratos and his son Atreus journey through the Norse realms, with Kratos confronting his violent past as a Greek god of war.

Name: The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt
Description: Monster hunter Geralt of Rivia searches for his adopted daughter Ciri across a war-torn open world in this narrative-driven RPG.

Name: Minecraft
Description: A block-building sandbox game where players gather resources, craft tools, and construct anything they can imagine across procedurally generated worlds.

Name: Half-Life 2
Description: Gordon Freeman fights to liberate Earth from the alien Combine in this landmark physics-driven first-person shooter.

Name: Portal 2
Description: Chell solves increasingly complex portal-based puzzles inside the Aperture Science facility, aided and antagonized by the AI GLaDOS.

Name: Final Fantasy VII
Description: Cloud Strife and the eco-terrorist group AVALANCHE fight the megacorporation Shinra and the reappearing villain Sephiroth to save the planet.

Name: Chrono Trigger
Description: A time-traveling RPG following Crono and his companions as they work to prevent a global catastrophe across different eras of history.

Name: Halo: Combat Evolved
Description: Master Chief battles the alien Covenant on a mysterious ringworld while uncovering the secrets of the Forerunners and the Flood.

Name: Metal Gear Solid
Description: Solid Snake infiltrates a nuclear weapons facility on Shadow Moses Island to stop a terrorist takeover led by FOXHOUND.

Name: Sonic the Hedgehog
Description: Sonic races through Green Hill Zone and beyond to stop Dr. Robotnik from harvesting animals to power his robot empire.

Name: Street Fighter II
Description: A roster of martial artists from around the world compete in a global fighting tournament, popularizing the competitive fighting genre.

Name: Overwatch
Description: A team-based hero shooter in which squads of heroes with unique abilities compete on objective-based maps.

Name: Elden Ring
Description: The Tarnished explores the Lands Between, an open world crafted with George R. R. Martin, to become the new Elden Lord.

Name: Animal Crossing: New Horizons
Description: Players develop a deserted island into a thriving community, collecting resources, decorating, and befriending anthropomorphic villagers.

Name: Cyberpunk 2077
Description: Mercenary V navigates the sprawling, dystopian metropolis of Night City in search of a mysterious implant that can grant immortality.
